status.en: 5 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 62% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 5 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 62 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iranian drones have struck Kurdish opposition bases in Sulaymaniyah, Erbil and northern Iraq, causing no casualties but prompting heightened security alerts. Iraqi security forces have arrested high-value ISIS suspects in Kirkuk and captured a notorious ISIS gang member, while also foiling petroleum-product smuggling in territorial waters. Political arrests continue with the former Mosul Sports Club president jailed for embezzlement and a Najaf council member jailed for defamation. Tensions in Basra expose growing security risks for Iraq and Kuwait. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske droner har rammet kurdiske opposisjonsbaser i Sulaymaniyah, Erbil og Nord-Irak, uten at noen ble drept, men med økte sikkerhetsvarsler. Iraks sikkerhetsstyrker har arrestert høyt verdsatte IS-mistenkte i Kirkuk og pågrepet et beryktet IS-gjengmedlem, samtidig som de har avverget smugling av petroleumsprodukter i territorialfarvannet. Politiske arrestasjoner fortsetter med den tidligere presidenten for Mosul Sports Club fengslet for underslag og et medlem av rådet i Najaf fengslet for ærekrenkelse. Spenninger i Basra avdekker økende sikkerhetsrisiko for Irak og Kuwait. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
